special_test_triggers.condition: anonymous redirect, login form, valid login, homepage, logout, and stale cookie paths are verified through real localhost HTTP requests
login credentials are supplied through environment variables instead of hardcoded values
logout clears server-side session state and stale cookies cannot access the homepage
Session tokens are stored in process-local memory; credentials are read from environment variables; no durable storage or external datasource is introduced.
Use environment-owned credentials, opaque HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookies, and server-side session invalidation.
Missing config, invalid form length, invalid credentials, unknown sessions, and unknown routes return readable failures.
Invalid login attempts remain visible in default HTTP access logs.
Credentials are supplied by LOGIN_HOMEPAGE_USERNAME and LOGIN_HOMEPAGE_PASSWORD environment variables.
